_comment: Draft settings for Claude Code. `.claude/` is gitignored, so this checked-in draft is the
installable form: merge the `hooks` block below into .claude/settings.local.json (or install
it with `ai/commands/init-agent.md`). Keep any existing keys — merge, never replace.
This file holds no rule of its own; it wires repository rules to one agent's hook surface.
PreToolUse enforces AGENTS.md section Committing through ai/hooks/deny-git-hook-bypass.sh.
SessionStart and PostToolUse keep the CodeGraph index current through
ai/hooks/sync-codegraph.sh, so the exploration workflow in AGENTS.md section Exploring code
answers from the tree as it is now.

hooks.statusMessage: Checking that Git hooks are not being skipped
